name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government-backed periodic pension scheme targeted at workers in the unorganised sector, delivering guaranteed monthly pensions of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 starting from 60 years of age.
target_beneficiaries: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years working in unorganised sectors
Individuals who are not income tax payers
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000, or Rs. 5,000 to the subscriber upon attaining 60 years of age. Upon subscriber demise, 100% pension continues to the spouse for life. Upon the demise of both subscriber and spouse, the entire accumulated pension corpus (Rs. 1.7 Lakh to Rs. 8.5 Lakh) is handed over to the nominee. Contributions depend on entry age (18-40) and chosen pension slab with a sovereign guarantee from the Central Government.
